searchText: i guess it seemed to me your response was conveying worry about where those JSON-RPC exposed nodes will be running and i wasn't quite clear why ie running along side validators. I wasn't quite sure why that made a difference whether they ran standalone or along side validators <@!301186049323958275> I think what you remembered was that the engine API would be at a different endpoint. Which it is suggested to be so The engine API is how CL controls EL and shouldn't be used by users The http beacon API is how users get info about the beacon chain. That is what my diagram suggests putting under a different namespace in common web3 libs
